zh.summary: 加拿大第二大航空公司 WestJet 於2026年7月30日發布72小時鎖場通知，回應工會 CUPE 8125 代表約4400名空服員提出的罷工預告。若雙方未能達成協議，工作停頓可能於8月2日凌晨起發生。WestJet 表示目前營運未受立即影響，並為7月30日至8月4日期間的旅客提供彈性改簽與取消政策。
body: 加拿大航空公司 WestJet 於2026年7月30日表示，在加拿大公共僱員工會（CUPE）8125分會宣布72小時罷工預告後，已發布自身的72小時鎖場通知。CUPE 8125 代表約4400名 WestJet 機艙組員。

WestJet 表示，相關通知不會立即影響營運，也不意味必然發生勞資中斷。航空公司為2026年7月30日至8月4日期間訂位的旅客提供彈性更改與取消政策，若發生航班延誤或取消，受影響旅客將獲得退款或重新安排航班。

en.title: WestJet Issues Lockout Notice in Response to 72-Hour Cabin Crew Strike Threat
en.summary: WestJet, Canada's second-largest airline, issued a 72-hour lockout notice on July 30, 2026, after CUPE 8125, representing approximately 4,400 cabin crew, served a strike notice. If no agreement is reached, a work stoppage could begin at 12:01 a.m. Mountain Time on August 2. WestJet says operations are not immediately affected and is offering flexible change and cancellation policies for passengers travelling between July 30 and August 4.
body: Canadian carrier WestJet said on July 30, 2026, that it was issuing a lockout notice after members of the Canadian Union of Public Employees (CUPE) 8125 announced a 72-hour strike notice. CUPE 8125 represents approximately 4,400 WestJet cabin crew.
If an agreement is not reached, a work stoppage could occur on August 2, 2026, at 12:01 a.m. Mountain Time. The lockout notice would prevent unionized employees from working.

Alexis von Hoensbroech, CEO of the WestJet Group, said the decision to issue a lockout notice was not made lightly and expressed sincere regret for the inconvenience and uncertainty caused. He said the airline's commitment remains at the bargaining table, where it will work 24 hours a day to reach a deal.

CUPE 8125 President Alia Hussain said the strike notice does not mean flight attendants want to commence industrial action, and the union's goal is to reach a fair agreement without disrupting passengers. She added there is still time to avoid a strike and the union will continue to bargain around the clock.

The union claims WestJet flight attendants carry out unpaid work up to 35 hours every month, including boarding, safety sweeps, assisting passengers, and ground delays. CUPE 8125 says pay is heavily tied to when the aircraft pushes back and is seeking compensation for all hours worked.

WestJet said the notices do not immediately impact operations or mean that a labor disruption will occur. The airline is offering flexible change and cancellation policies for guests with travel bookings between July 30, 2026, and August 4, 2026, and said impacted guests will be refunded or reaccommodated as applicable.

zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）於2026年7月30日在聯邦登記冊發布提案，擬允許該局在審查某些商業太空發射與再入許可時，豁免遵守13項聯邦環境與自然資源法律。提案涵蓋發射與再入載具、發射與再入場域以及實驗飛行許可。FAA指出，此舉可透過刪除被視為不必要或重複的環境審查來縮短審批時間，但在特定條件下僅在運輸部長諮詢相關聯邦機構後認定該法律不需保護公眾健康與安全、財產、國家安全或美國對外政策利益時才得適用。受影響法律包括國家環境政策法、瀕危物種法、清潔水法、清潔空氣法、國家史料保存法、海洋哺乳類保護法、海岸帶管理法、國家海洋聖殿法、噪音控制法、野生與風景河流法、河流與港口法、瑪格努森-史蒂文斯漁業保暨管理法及運輸部法部分條款。公眾意見徵求期間將持續至2026年8月31日。

en.title: FAA Proposes Waiving Environmental Reviews to Accelerate Commercial Space Launches
en.summary: On July 30, 2026, the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) published a notice in the Federal Register proposing to allow the agency to waive compliance with 13 federal environmental and natural-resource statutes when reviewing certain commercial space launch and reentry licenses and permits. The waiver would cover launch and reentry vehicles, launch and reentry sites, and experimental flight permits. FAA says the change could shorten approval times by eliminating reviews it deems unnecessary or duplicative, but only when the Transportation Secretary, after consulting the appropriate federal agency, determines a legal requirement is not needed to protect public health and safety, property, national security, or U.S. foreign policy interests. The affected statutes include the National Environmental Policy Act, Endangered Species Act, Clean Water Act, Clean Air Act, National Historic Preservation Act, Marine Mammal Protection Act, Coastal Zone Management Act, National Marine Sanctuaries Act, Noise Control Act, Wild and Scenic Rivers Act, Rivers and Harbors Act, Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act, and part of the Department of Transportation Act. The public comment period runs through August 31, 2026. FAA noted that in some cases waiving its review may shift responsibility to another federal agency rather than eliminate the review entirely.
body: FAA emphasized that commercial space activity is surging and that the current regulatory process involves multiple laws and agencies, leading to overlapping reviews and delays.
The proposal would apply only to licenses and permits issued or modified after a final rule takes effect; FAA will review public comments before deciding whether to adopt the change.

According to FAA data, it authorized a record 204 commercial space operations in fiscal year 2025, forecasts 214 for 2026, and as many as 507 annually by 2036, and expects up to 4,288 operations over the next decade.

The initiative follows an August 2025 executive order directing federal agencies to speed approvals for commercial launches, spacecraft reentries, and spaceport projects, and relies on authority under the Commercial Space Launch Act that permits the Transportation Secretary to waive a federal legal requirement for a license or permit under certain conditions.

zh.title: GKN承製BAE Systems的Brontanax戰用無人機翼面組件
zh.summary: GKN Aerospace透露已完成BAE Systems的Brontanax協同戰鬥飛機機翼與控制面整合。該無人機原型最大起飛重量超過5公噸，由BAE Systems自籌逾4億英鎊開發，預計2026年第三季通電、2027年進行地面測試與首飛，並預計換裝勞斯萊斯發動機。
body: GKN Aerospace宣布已完成BAE Systems最新款Brontanax協同戰鬥飛機（Collaborative Combat Aircraft, CCA）的機翼、尾翼與控制面工程設計、製造及原型機整合。這項機體結構組件已具備飛行準備狀態，由GKN Aerospace位於英國懷特島考斯（Cowes）的複合材料設計與組裝設施生產，並協同集團多個據點進行研發製造。

Brontanax無人戰鬥機原型機係由BAE Systems於2026年7月22日舉行的范保羅國際航展（Farnborough International Airshow）上正式公開發表。該專案主要由BAE Systems位於蘭開夏郡沃頓（Warton）的團隊秘藏開發，並由其旗下FalconWorks快速開發單位主導設計。自2022年啟動概念研究以來，BAE Systems已投入超過4億英鎊（約5.35億美元）的自籌資金，並動用逾500名員工與約75家英國供應商。
在規格與時程方面，Brontanax尺寸約與鷹式（Hawk）教練機相當，最大起飛重量超過5公噸。原型機目前配備Williams International發動機，但BAE Systems預計未來將過渡至勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）Orpheus系列發動機。該專案預計於2026年第三季末完成通電，並計劃於2027年上半年開展地面測試，隨後於2027年晚些時候進行首次飛行測試。
Brontanax為BAE Systems針對英國皇家空軍（Royal Air Force）「風暴戰鬥機」（Storm Fighter）需求所研製的方案。根據英國最新國防投資計畫，政府已撥款3億英鎊（約4億美元）用於忠誠伴飛無人機（loyal wingman）的開發作業。這項發展亦進一步擴展了GKN Aerospace在英國自主無人機領域的合作佈局。

en.title: GKN Aerospace Reveals Role in BAE Systems Brontanax Drone Development
en.summary: GKN Aerospace has revealed its role in manufacturing and integrating the wings, fins, and control surfaces for BAE Systems' Brontanax Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) prototype, which was unveiled at the Farnborough International Airshow in July 2026. BAE Systems has invested more than £400 million ($535 million) in self-funding into the uncrewed fighter program since 2022. The aircraft has a maximum takeoff weight exceeding five metric tons and is currently powered by a Williams International engine, with plans to transition to a Rolls-Royce Orpheus engine ahead of initial flight tests targeted for 2027.
body: GKN Aerospace has announced the completion of the engineering, manufacturing, and full prototype integration of the wings, fins, and control surfaces for BAE Systems' Brontanax Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA). The flight-ready structures were produced at GKN Aerospace's composite design and assembly facility at Cowes on the Isle of Wight, utilizing capabilities coordinated across several of the group's manufacturing sites following an accelerated development process from a clean-sheet design.

BAE Systems officially unveiled the Brontanax uncrewed combat aircraft prototype at the Farnborough International Airshow on July 22, 2026. Positioned as a pre-series, pre-production prototype, the aircraft was developed largely in secret at BAE Systems' Warton site in Lancashire under the leadership of its FalconWorks rapid development unit. BAE Systems has committed over £400 million ($535 million) of its own funds to the program since concept work initiated in 2022, drawing on more than 500 employees and approximately 75 UK suppliers.

The aircraft is roughly equivalent in size to a Hawk trainer, featuring a maximum take-off weight exceeding five metric tons. While the prototype is currently fitted with a Williams International engine, BAE Systems expects to transition to a powerplant from the Rolls-Royce Orpheus engine family. According to the development schedule, system power-on is slated for the end of the third quarter of 2026, with ground trials planned for the first half of 2027 and the maiden flight anticipated later that year.

Brontanax represents BAE Systems' submission to meet the Royal Air Force's Storm Fighter requirement, under which the latest Defence Investment Plan allocates £300 million ($400 million) to loyal wingman development. The project adds to GKN Aerospace's expanding portfolio in British uncrewed defense aviation, complementing its ongoing involvement in other defense technology partnerships and propulsion programs.

body: 一架英國航空（British Airways）航班在進場階段發生大氣數據參考故障，機組員先宣告PAN PAN後升級為MAYDAY，後由機長介入接管操作。

報導指該事件最終由機長緊急介入後解除危機，實際航班編號、具體發生日期、機場及航機型號等細節尚未在該報導中揭露。

zh.summary: 飛機製造商JetZero於2026年7月下旬的范保羅國際航空展期間，與美國進出口銀行簽署意向書，探索為其位於北卡羅來納州格林斯伯勒的Z4翼身融合飛機製造廠提供最多30億美元的融資支持。該初步協議不構成最終貸款承諾，JetZero預計總投資額將超過47億美元。
body: 飛機製造商JetZero於2026年7月下旬的范保羅國際航空展期間，與美國進出口銀行（EXIM）簽署意向書，探討為其位於北卡羅來納州格林斯伯勒皮德蒙特特里亞德國際機場的Z4翼身融合飛機製造廠提供最高達30億美元的融資支持。
這項初步協議隸屬於該銀行的「美國製造」計畫，可用於支援製造設施、生產系統及設備等相關成本。然而，該意向書並不構成法律上的融資承諾或貸款批准，最終協議仍須通過審查、盡職調查、環境與法律評估，以及銀行董事會的正式批准。
JetZero預計將在該佔地超過600英畝的廠區投資超過47億美元，建造面積達800萬平方呎的製造與總裝中心，並計畫在未來十年內創造約14,500個直接工作機會。此外，該公司正針對民航市場開發載客量約250人、航程可達5,000海浬的Z4混合翼飛機。

en.title: JetZero Signs $3B Financing Letter of Interest with US EXIM Bank for Z4 Plant
en.summary: Aircraft developer JetZero has signed a letter of interest with the US Export-Import Bank to explore up to $3 billion in potential financing support for its planned Z4 aircraft factory in Greensboro, North Carolina. Signed during the Farnborough International Airshow in late July 2026, the preliminary agreement could assist with facility construction and equipment costs under EXIM's Make More in America Initiative. JetZero expects the overall campus investment to exceed $4.7 billion, though EXIM emphasized that the letter does not constitute a formal loan commitment or federal financial obligation.
body: Aircraft manufacturer JetZero has signed a letter of interest with the US Export-Import Bank (EXIM) during the Farnborough International Airshow in late July 2026. The preliminary agreement explores providing up to $3 billion in financing support for a planned Z4 blended-wing aircraft factory at Piedmont Triad International Airport in Greensboro, North Carolina.

The potential financing, framed under EXIM's Make More in America Initiative, could support construction, equipment, and production systems. However, the letter does not constitute a formal financing commitment or loan approval, remaining subject to underwriting, due diligence, environmental reviews, and board approval.

JetZero expects to invest more than $4.7 billion in the 8 million-square-foot complex, targeting the creation of approximately 14,500 direct jobs over the next decade while developing its 250-passenger Z4 commercial aircraft.

zh.title: 新加坡航空集團公布第一季淨虧損7600萬星元，燃料成本飆升抵銷創紀錄營收
zh.summary: 新加坡航空集團截至2026年6月30日止第一季錄得7600萬星元淨虧損，較上年同期1.86億星元淨利大幅逆轉。儘管營收創下57.1億星元歷史新高，燃料成本暴增78.5%侵蝕獲利，集團將此歸因於中東衝突推高噴射燃料價格。
body: 新加坡航空集團公布截至2026年6月30日止第一季財報，錄得7600萬星元（約5900萬美元）淨虧損，與上年同期1.86億星元（約1.43億美元）淨利相比出現大幅逆轉。AeroTime報導指出，此一虧損「幾乎完全由與中東衝突相關的燃料成本飆升所驅動」。
第一季營收達57.1億星元（約44億美元），較上年同期成長19.3%，創下集團歷史新高。客運營收成長18.6%至45.8億星元（約35.3億美元），新加坡航空與低成本子公司Scoot合計載運1090萬人次旅客，較上年成長6.3%，客運收益率亦上升12%。
貨運營收同樣成長33.5%至7.08億星元（約5.45億美元），受惠於更強的貨運費率與較高的飛機使用率。然而，集團總支出跳增27.9%至56.1億星元（約43.2億美元），主因為淨燃料成本增加9.91億星元（約7.63億美元），增幅達78.5%。
營業利益因此降至1.06億星元（約8200萬美元），較上年同期的4.05億星元（約3.12億美元）下滑73.8%。在計入持有25.1%股權的印度航空較大份額虧損及較小稅額後，集團最終錄得7600萬星元淨虧損。
儘管面臨虧損，集團財務狀況維持穩健，季末持有91億星元現金及銀行存款，較上季增加11.7億星元。集團同時持續擴張航網，Scoot開通新加坡至印尼Belitung及Pontianak航線，新加坡航空則開通每日飛往杭州的航班。
中東衝突亦影響集團部分航網運作。Scoot於6月恢飛沙烏地阿拉伯吉達航班，但於7月中旬再度暫停。新加坡航空飛往杜拜的航班維持暫停，原訂開通的利雅德航班則延至12月。

en.title: Singapore Airlines Group posts S$76 million Q1 net loss as fuel costs surge despite record revenue
en.summary: Singapore Airlines Group reported a net loss of S$76 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, a sharp reversal from S$186 million profit a year earlier. Record revenue of S$5.71 billion was outweighed by a 78.5% surge in fuel costs, which the group attributed to Middle East conflict driving up jet fuel prices.
body: Singapore Airlines Group reported a net loss of S$76 million (US$59 million) for its first fiscal quarter ended June 30, 2026, a sharp reversal from the S$186 million (US$143 million) profit posted a year earlier. AeroTime reported the loss was driven almost entirely by a spike in fuel costs tied to the conflict in the Middle East.

Revenue for the quarter reached S$5.71 billion (US$4.40 billion), up 19.3% year-on-year and a new high for the group. Passenger revenue climbed 18.6% to S$4.58 billion (US$3.53 billion), with Singapore Airlines and budget carrier Scoot carrying a combined 10.9 million passengers, up 6.3% from the previous year, alongside a 12% rise in passenger yields.

Cargo revenue also grew 33.5% to S$708 million (US$545 million), supported by stronger cargo rates and improved aircraft utilisation. However, total group expenditure jumped 27.9% to S$5.61 billion (US$4.32 billion), almost entirely because of a S$991 million (US$763 million), or 78.5%, increase in net fuel costs.

Operating profit fell to S$106 million (US$82 million), down 73.8% from S$405 million (US$312 million) a year earlier. After accounting for a larger share of losses from Air India, in which SIA holds a 25.1% stake, and a smaller tax bill, the group ended the quarter S$76 million in the red.

Despite the loss, the group's finances remain solid, closing the quarter with S$9.10 billion in cash and bank balances, up S$1.17 billion from the previous quarter. The group continued expanding its network, with Scoot launching new routes to Belitung and Pontianak in Indonesia and SIA beginning daily service to Hangzhou.

The Middle East conflict also disrupted parts of the network. Scoot resumed flights to Jeddah in June only to suspend them again in mid-July. SIA's services to Dubai remain suspended, and the planned launch of flights to Riyadh has been pushed back to December.

en.summary: Australia’s civil aviation authority released the country’s first national standard operating procedures for large air‑tanker firefighting aircraft on 29 July 2026, following the crash of a Boeing 737 that was conducting a fire‑suppression mission. The new SOPs set minimum drop altitudes, crew qualification standards and require all operating crews to complete specialised training and pass assessment. The regulations also mandate real‑time weather monitoring during drops and establish a reporting framework for any deviation from the prescribed parameters.
body: Australia’s civil aviation authority released the country’s first national standard operating procedures for large air‑tanker firefighting aircraft on 29 July 2026, following the crash of a Boeing 737 conducting a fire‑suppression mission.
The SOPs set minimum drop altitudes, crew qualification thresholds and require all operating crews to complete specialised training and pass assessment.

According to AeroTime, this marks the first time Australia has established a national‑level air‑tanker operating standard, and the authority will also implement real‑time weather monitoring and a deviation reporting framework.
The new rules are expected to improve inter‑agency coordination and reduce risk on future firefighting missions.

zh.title: 民間團體質疑高鐵延伸宜蘭效益與3521億預算
zh.summary: 台灣前進陣線於29日舉行記者會，質疑行政院核定總經費新台幣3521億元的高鐵延伸宜蘭計畫。團體指出，環評報告顯示該計畫僅能舒緩國道5號平日3.1%與假日6.8%的交通量，無法解決塞車瓶頸，要求行政院公開選擇及替代方案成本效益分析與相關細節。
body: 台灣前進陣線於29日上午舉行記者會並遞交陳情書，表達對行政院核定高鐵延伸宜蘭計畫的疑慮。團體指出，根據環評報告，高鐵延伸宜蘭只能舒緩國道5號平日3.1%、假日6.8%的交通量，無法完全解決交通瓶頸問題，換算改善比率與經費後，反對在效益與規劃尚不清晰的情況下支出新台幣3521億元。
行政院長卓榮泰於23日拍板核定高鐵延伸宜蘭計畫，規劃路線全長60.6公里，總經費為新台幣3521億元，預計南港至宜蘭車程為28分鐘，估算核定後11年完工。未來台鐵將於高鐵宜蘭站共構設站，方便民眾無縫轉乘。
時代力量、小民參政歐巴桑聯盟、台灣基進及台灣綠黨組成的台灣前進陣線要求行政院公開計畫細節。遞交的陳情書提出，行政院應說明核定函、國發會審議意見、可行性研究修正報告與綜合規劃報告，並提供高鐵、直鐵、台鐵提速等替代方案的比較資料，同時登載完整的中長程計畫要點。
陳情書亦要求公開此案是否依預算法第34條完成選擇及替代方案成本效益分析並載明財源說明。若未完成，不得列入預算送立法院備查或編列工程經費。行政院交通環境資源處代表於現場收下陳情，並強調將督促相關部會依規定對外說明。
時代力量黨主席王婉諭表示，政府15年前曾評估「北宜直鐵」方案，預算為668億元，台北到宜蘭車程為37分鐘；去年環評報告書亦提及興建直鐵預算為1321億元。相較之下，高鐵延伸宜蘭預算大幅暴增，詳細規劃與實際效益亟需向外界釐清。

en.title: Civic Groups Question Cost and Benefits of NT$352B Yilan High Speed Rail Extension
en.summary: The Taiwan Forward Front held a press conference on July 29 to question the Executive Yuan's approval of the NT$352.1 billion High Speed Rail Yilan extension project. Citing the environmental impact assessment report, the coalition highlighted that the extension would only relieve 3.1% of weekday traffic and 6.8% of holiday traffic on Freeway 5, failing to resolve the corridor's congestion bottleneck. The civic group submitted a petition requesting the Cabinet release detailed project evaluations, including mandatory cost-benefit analyses and comparisons with alternative transportation proposals.
body: The Taiwan Forward Front held a press conference on July 29 to express concerns over the Executive Yuan's approval of the High Speed Rail Yilan extension project. Citing figures from the project's environmental impact assessment report, the civic coalition pointed out that the extension would relieve only 3.1% of weekday traffic and 6.8% of holiday traffic on Freeway 5, failing to resolve the regional congestion bottleneck.

Premier Cho Jung-tai approved the High Speed Rail Yilan extension project on July 23. The planned 60.6-kilometer route carries a total budget of NT$352.1 billion, with an expected travel time of 28 minutes between Nangang and Yilan. Construction is estimated to take 11 years following official approval, and Taiwan Railway plans to co-locate a station at the Yilan HSR terminus to facilitate transfers.

Composed of the New Power Party, Taiwan Small People's Party, Taiwan Statebuilding Party, and Taiwan Green Party, the coalition submitted a petition to the Cabinet. The group called for full public disclosure of project documentation, including the official approval letter, National Development Council review opinions, revised feasibility studies, and direct comparisons with alternative options such as direct conventional rail or speed upgrades.

The petition further demanded clarification on whether the government has completed the mandatory cost-benefit analysis of alternative options under Article 34 of the Budget Act. The coalition argued that funding should not be submitted to the Legislative Yuan for review prior to completing these legal requirements. A representative from the Executive Yuan's Department of Transportation, Environmental and Resources accepted the petition and promised to urge relevant agencies to make public explanations.

New Power Party Chairperson Wang Wan-yu noted that a previous North Yilan Direct Rail proposal evaluated 15 years ago carried a budget of NT$66.8 billion, while last year's environmental report cited an estimated cost of NT$132.1 billion for the direct rail option. The coalition questioned the substantial budget increase for the high-speed rail extension compared to earlier alternatives.

body: 美國運輸部長Sean P. Duffy表示，美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）正在推動一項新計畫，旨在精簡商業太空許可審查流程，加速火箭發射、太空船重返大氣層及營運場地的核准作業。根據FAA提出的新規定草案，該機構將被允許針對特定商業太空許可與執照，豁免13項聯邦法律的相關要求。

en.title: US DOT and FAA Propose New Rule to Streamline Commercial Space Licensing
en.summary: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced a new Federal Aviation Administration initiative aimed at streamlining commercial space licensing for rocket launches, spacecraft reentries, and site operations. Under the proposed rule, the FAA would be authorized to waive requirements under 13 federal laws for certain commercial space licenses and permits. The agency emphasized that mandatory requirements protecting public health, safety, property, national security, or foreign policy interests will remain unaffected. The proposed rule includes a 30-day public comment period, during which the agency will gather and review feedback before finalizing the regulation.
body: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced that the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is introducing a new initiative designed to streamline commercial space licensing. The proposed rule would allow the agency to waive requirements from 13 federal laws for certain commercial space licenses and permits, aiming to accelerate approvals for rocket launches, spacecraft reentries, and launch site operations.

The FAA specified that regulatory requirements necessary to safeguard public health and safety, property, national security, or U.S. foreign policy interests will not be affected by the waivers. The rulemaking proposal opens a 30-day public comment period, during which the FAA will collect and review submissions before issuing a final rule.

zh.title: 國際航空運輸協會與CANSO及ACI推出跑道安全倡議
zh.summary: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）、民航空航服務組織（CANSO）以及國際機場協會（ACI）於2026年7月28日宣布推出「聯合跑道安全倡議」，旨在降低跑道入侵風險。該倡議將聚焦於改善安全報告與資料擷取、強化地方跑道安全小組，以及跨機場分享經驗教訓三大核心領域。
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）、民航空航服務組織（CANSO）與國際機場協會（ACI）於2026年7月28日聯合宣布，正式推出「聯合跑道安全倡議」（Joint Runway Safety Initiative），以降低航空營運中的跑道入侵風險。跑道入侵被定義為航空器、車輛或人員錯誤地位於跑道或其保護區域內。鑑於跑道入侵對航空安全構成重大風險，三大組織強調預防此類事件需要航空公司、機場、空航服務提供者、主管機關及一線人員之間的緊密協調。
此項聯合倡議聚焦於三大核心領域：第一，改善安全報告與資料擷取，涵蓋事故、近距離錯失事件、前兆事件以及一線人員的觀察紀錄；第二，強化地方跑道安全小組，使其成為航空公司、機場與空航服務提供者評估在地風險並達成協調行動的主要平台；第三，促進經驗教訓與進展的分享，以便營運環境相似的機場與機構能更廣泛地採用有效做法。

IATA營運、安全暨安保資深副總裁Nick Careen指出，保持最高安全紀錄需要持續改進，此倡議將航空公司、機場與空航服務提供者凝聚在一起，有助於提早識別跑道風險並採取協調行動。CANSO全球營運資深副總裁Andrea Sack亦表示，跑道安全仰賴跨機場環境的清晰溝通與協調決策，強大的地方跑道安全小組能將各方營運夥伴結合在一起。ACI World安全、安保暨營運副總裁Darryl Dowd則強調，地方知識與持續合作能將安全指引轉化為實質風險降低。

該倡議建立在現有的全球安全機制之上，包括由ICAO、Eurocontrol及飛行安全基金會（Flight Safety Foundation）合作並獲IATA、ACI與CANSO認可的「全球預防跑道入侵行動計劃」（GAPPRI），以及ICAO「全球跑道安全行動計劃」。三大組織將運用包含風險評估資源、跑道安全檢核表、ACI在APEX安全計畫下的跑道安全小組實施套件、IATA跑道入侵安全風險評估工具，以及透過IOSA計畫進行的航空公司風險評估評估等工具，進一步推進全球跑道安全目標。

en.title: IATA CANSO and ACI Launch Joint Initiative to Reduce Runway Incursions
en.summary: The International Air Transport Association (IATA), the Civil Air Navigation Services Organisation (CANSO), and Airports Council International (ACI) have launched a joint initiative on July 28, 2026, aimed at reducing the risk of runway incursions across global aviation operations. The Joint Runway Safety Initiative focuses on improving safety reporting and data capture, strengthening local runway safety teams, and sharing progress and lessons learned among industry stakeholders to enhance airport safety standards.
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA), the Civil Air Navigation Services Organisation (CANSO), and Airports Council International (ACI) officially launched the Joint Runway Safety Initiative on July 28, 2026. The collaborative program is designed to mitigate the risk of runway incursions, defined as any incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle, or person on a runway or within its designated protected area. The organizations emphasized that preventing incursions requires synchronized coordination among airlines, airport operators, air navigation service providers, regulators, and frontline operational personnel.

The joint initiative focuses its efforts on three core operational pillars. First, it aims to improve safety reporting and data collection, capturing detailed records of incidents, near misses, precursor events, and frontline observations. Second, it seeks to strengthen Local Runway Safety Teams, establishing them as the primary collaborative forum for local stakeholders to assess specific risks and agree on aligned operational actions. Third, the initiative will facilitate the widespread sharing of progress and lessons learned, allowing airports with similar operational environments to adopt proven safety practices.

Industry leadership highlighted the crucial role of multi-stakeholder collaboration in maintaining safety standards. Nick Careen, IATA Senior Vice President of Operations, Safety, and Security, stated that bringing airlines, airports, and navigation service providers together enables earlier identification of runway risks and coordinated action. Andrea Sack, Senior Vice President of Global Operations at CANSO, noted that runway safety relies on clear communication and joint decisions across airport environments. Darryl Dowd, Vice President of Safety, Security, and Operations at ACI World, added that local knowledge and sustained cooperation are key to translating guidance into tangible risk reductions.

The Joint Runway Safety Initiative builds upon existing global frameworks, including the Global Action Plan for the Prevention of Runway Incursions (GAPPRI)—developed by ICAO, Eurocontrol, and the Flight Safety Foundation—as well as the ICAO Global Runway Safety Action Plan. To further these goals, the partner organizations are deploying tools such as ACI's APEX in Safety implementation packages, CANSO and ACI co-developed safety checklists, IATA's Runway Incursion Safety Risk Assessment, and airline evaluations through the IOSA program.

en.title: Qatar Airways Boeing 777 Intercepted by RAF Typhoons Following Hoax Bomb Threat Report
en.summary: According to Simple Flying, a Qatar Airways Boeing 777 was intercepted by Royal Air Force Typhoon fighters after a reported bomb threat. Police have questioned a 14-year-old boy in connection with the hoax alert. No injuries or aircraft damage have been reported.
body: Simple Flying published the story on 2026-07-27 at 08:32 UTC, stating that a Qatar Airways Boeing 777 was intercepted by RAF Typhoon jets after a bomb threat was reported. The article did not disclose the flight number or route.
The threat was later determined to be a hoax, prompting police to question a 14-year-old boy regarding the false alarm. Investigations into who made the threat are ongoing.
To date, no official statements have indicated any passenger or crew injuries, nor any damage to the aircraft. The incident remains under investigation, with further details pending release.

zh.title: 審計部指無人機防禦系統漏頻段 國防部承諾更新
zh.summary: 審計部年度決算報告指出空軍委託中科院建置的固定式無人機防禦系統未涵蓋中國5.1GHz頻段及北斗部分頻段，對光纖與AI自主無人機幾無反制，進度嚴重落後；國防部發言人孫立方表示將透過系統更新納入新頻段，並由國防創新小組尋求或自研光纖、AI反制能力。
body: 審計部公布的民國114年度中央政府總決算審核報告指出，空軍統籌委託國家中山科學研究院建置固定式「遙控無人機防禦系統」，但該系統偵測、干擾頻段未涵蓋中國近年推出5.1GHz新機型，干擾衛星導航範圍也漏掉中國北斗3號部分頻段，且對光纖式無人機、AI自主導航無人機幾無反制手段，建置進度持續落後。
國防部發言人孫立方中將表示，中國後來在112年提出的5.1GHz頻段在台灣並非合法使用頻段，但中科院會透過系統更新方式，納入偵蒐及反制無人機設備中。
至於反制光纖、AI導控無人機方式，孫立方指出這確實是新的發展，也非110年的建案中，但國防部會透過國防創新小組（DIU）尋找國外成熟商源，或透過自行研發等方式去籌獲反制系統。
立法院經濟、外交及國防、財政委員會上午第2次聯席會議，針對行政院版、國民黨及民眾黨版無人機條例草案進行逐條審查。
中科院所建置的無人機反制系統於110年建案，是針對2.4GHz、5.8GHz、1.2GHz、1.5GHz，共4個一、二類無人機頻段建置。

en.title: Audit Finds UAV Defense System Misses New Chinese Frequencies; MOD Pledges Updates
en.summary: The Audit Department's 2025 final audit report says the Air Force‑commissioned fixed UAV defense system built by NCSIST does not cover China's new 5.1 GHz band nor parts of the BeiDou‑3 navigation frequencies, and lacks countermeasures against fiber‑optic and AI‑guided drones, with deployment seriously behind schedule. The Ministry of Defense spokesperson said the 5.1 GHz band is not legal in Taiwan but NCSIST will add it via a system update, and the MOD will seek mature foreign solutions through the Defense Innovation Unit or develop domestic capabilities for fiber‑optic and AI drone threats.
body: The Audit Department's 114th‑year central government final audit report states that the Air Force tasked the National Chung‑Shan Institute of Science and Technology (NCSIST) to build a fixed “remote‑controlled UAV defense system,” but its detection and jamming bands do not cover China's recent 5.1 GHz models, miss parts of the BeiDou‑3 frequencies, and have almost no countermeasures against fiber‑optic or AI‑autonomous UAVs, with deployment progress continuing to lag.

MOD spokesperson Lieutenant General Sun Li‑fang said the 5.1 GHz band introduced by China in 2023 is not a legal band in Taiwan, but NCSIST will incorporate it into detection and counter‑UAV equipment through a system update.

Regarding fiber‑optic and AI‑guided UAV countermeasures, Sun noted this is a new development not covered in the original 2021 plan, and the MOD will pursue mature foreign sources via the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) or develop indigenous solutions to acquire such capabilities.

The Legislative Yuan’s joint committee of the Economic, Foreign Affairs, National Defense, and Finance committees held its second meeting to conduct a clause‑by‑clause review of the Executive Yuan, KMT, and TPP draft UAV regulations.
The NCSIST‑built UAV countermeasure system was originally planned in 2021 targeting four frequency bands: 2.4 GHz, 5.8 GHz, 1.2 GHz, and 1.5 GHz.

zh.summary: 民航局發布新聞稿，因紅霞颱風預計明日國際線取消22架次，要求航空公司保守派遣、帶足油料並備妥兩處以上備降機場，且已通知旅客辦理改退票；截至晚間11點國內線取消20架次、延誤3架次，國際線取消2架次，桃園機場22班因強陣風轉降松山、台中、高雄、香港、澳門
body: 交通部民用航空局於115年7月24日發布新聞稿，指出受紅霞颱風影響，明日國際線預計有22架次航班取消。
民航局指出，今日截至晚間11點，國內線取消20架次、延誤3架次，國際線取消2架次。
今晚間截至11點，桃園機場共有22班航班因強陣風與風切影響，轉降松山、台中、高雄等機場，亦有航機轉降香港、澳門等地。
民航局同時要求業者應保守派遣，航班應帶足油料，並備妥備降機場。
航空公司已以簡訊、電子郵件、官網、APP等管道主動通知旅客航班異動資訊，民航局也要求航空公司應依據天候狀況盡力協助旅客辦理改票、退票或改搭其他適當航班等事宜。

en.title: CAA orders conservative dispatch and alternates as Typhoon Hongxia forces 22 international cancellations
en.summary: The Civil Aeronautics Administration issued a press release on 24 July 2026 stating that Typhoon Hongxia is expected to cause 22 international flight cancellations tomorrow. Airlines are ordered to operate conservatively, carry sufficient fuel, and prepare at least two alternate airports, one outside the typhoon’s impact zone. Carriers have notified passengers via SMS, email, website and app and must assist with rebooking or refunds. As of 23:00 today, 20 domestic flights were cancelled and three delayed, with two international cancellations; 22 flights at Taoyuan were diverted to Songshan, Taichung, Kaohsiung, Hong Kong and Macau due to gusts and wind shear.
body: The Civil Aeronautics Administration released a statement on 24 July 2026 saying Typhoon Hongxia will likely force 22 international flight cancellations tomorrow.
As of 23:00 today, 20 domestic flights were cancelled and three delayed, while two international flights were cancelled.
At 23:00, 22 flights at Taoyuan Airport were diverted to Songshan, Taichung, Kaohsiung, Hong Kong and Macau because of strong gusts and wind shear.
The CAA requires airlines to operate conservatively, carry sufficient fuel, and have alternate airports ready.
Airlines have notified passengers via SMS, email, website and app and must assist with rebooking or refunds according to weather conditions.

zh.title: 聯合防禦操演驗證直屬參謀本部戰略預備隊應變能量
zh.summary: 國軍於7月13至17日舉行聯合防禦操演，知情人士稱已驗證直屬參謀本部戰略預備隊應變能量；學者蘇紫雲指出戰略預備隊為核心編制，涵蓋陸航601旅阿帕契直升機及跨域機動部隊，將在漢光實兵想定中保障核心設施安全，並預計在關鍵時刻鞏固政經核心與關鍵基礎設施安全。
body: 國軍於7月13日至17日舉行聯合防禦操演，知情人士指出此次操演已驗證直屬參謀本部的戰略預備隊應變能量。
國防部智庫國防安全研究院學者蘇紫雲接受訪問時說明，戰略預備隊是軍事作戰上的核心組織結構，指揮官通常保留一個營作為戰術活棋，並在第一線遭突破時快速反應、填補缺口。
蘇紫雲指出，戰略預備隊不受單一戰區轄制；配備AH-64E阿帕契攻擊直升機的陸航601旅部分單位即直屬參謀本部，具備高速機動、跨越水陸空界面的部隊以及空軍聯隊、部分海軍兵力均可在戰略預備隊想定中扮演重要角色。
學者推測，在漢光實兵等聯合作戰想定下，戰略預備隊已不再局限於單一陸上打擊，而是涵蓋陸海空軍戰力，屆時將於關鍵時刻鞏固並確保政經核心、關鍵基礎設施的安全。
此次操演結束後，國防部持續強化訓練力度及制度改革，以因應共軍近年持續的文攻武嚇與周邊海空域侵擾。

en.title: Joint defense exercise verifies strategic reserve under General Staff
en.summary: The ROC armed forces conducted a joint defense exercise from July 13 to 17. Informed sources said the drill verified the response capability of the strategic reserve directly subordinate to the General Staff. Scholar Su Tzu‑yun of the Institute for National Defense and Security Research explained that the strategic reserve is a core organisational element, kept as a tactical reserve for rapid reinforcement. He noted that units such as the Army Aviation 601st Brigade equipped with AH‑64E Apache helicopters, high‑speed cross‑domain forces, Air Force wings and Navy assets can all serve in the strategic reserve. Su speculated that under Han Kuang live‑force scenarios the reserve would encompass joint land, sea and air power to protect political‑economic centres and critical infrastructure at decisive moments.
body: The ROC armed forces held a joint defense exercise from July 13 to 17, and informed sources said the drill verified the response capability of the strategic reserve directly subordinate to the General Staff.

Su Tzu‑yun, a scholar at the Institute for National Defense and Security Research, explained that the strategic reserve is a core organisational element, typically retained as a tactical reserve for rapid reinforcement when front‑line units are breached.

Su noted that the strategic reserve is not confined to a single theater; the Army Aviation 601st Brigade, which operates AH‑64E Apache attack helicopters, has elements directly under the General Staff, and high‑speed cross‑domain units, Air Force wings and Navy forces can all be assigned to the reserve.

He speculated that under Han Kuang live‑force scenarios the strategic reserve would no longer be limited to land strike but would integrate land, sea and air power to secure political‑economic centres and critical infrastructure at critical moments.
The Ministry of National Defense continues to intensify training and institutional reforms to counter the PLA’s ongoing gray‑zone pressure and frequent incursions around Taiwan.

en.title: FAA Proposes $263,750 and $50,000 Fines Against Southern Airways Express for Alleged Violations
en.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration proposed a $263,750 civil penalty against Southern Airways Express of Addison, Texas, for allegedly operating a Cessna Caravan with a malfunctioning autopilot on 29 commercial flights in April 2025. The agency also proposed a $50,000 penalty against the carrier for allegedly violating weight-and-balance regulations that caused an incident when an airplane pushed back from the gate. Southern Airways Express has 30 days to respond to the notices.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration proposed a $263,750 civil penalty against Southern Airways Express of Addison, Texas, for allegedly operating a Cessna Caravan with a malfunctioning autopilot on 29 commercial flights in April 2025. The agency alleges the autopilot was inoperative required equipment, violating the carrier's Operations Specifications.

The FAA also proposed a $50,000 civil penalty against Southern Airways Express, LCC of Addison, Texas, for allegedly violating weight-and-balance regulations that caused an incident when an airplane pushed back from the gate. Southern Airways Express has 30 days after receiving the notices to respond.

en.title: FAA to Issue Final Rule on 5G Interference with Radio Altimeters July 24
en.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced on July 22 that it will issue a final rule on July 24, 2026, requiring all aircraft radio altimeters operating in the United States to meet next-generation performance requirements to ensure they can withstand interference from 5G wireless signals in neighboring spectrum bands. The rule aims to address longstanding concerns about potential interference between 5G networks and aircraft altimeters, which are critical for low-visibility landings and terrain awareness.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced it will issue a final rule on July 24, 2026, addressing aircraft radio altimeter performance in the presence of 5G wireless signals in adjacent spectrum bands.
The rule will require all radio altimeters equipped on aircraft operating in the United States to meet next-generation performance standards to ensure they can withstand interference from 5G signals.

According to the Federal Aviation Administration, the civil penalty is being proposed due to alleged training violations. Specifically, the regulator alleged that Simulator Center LLC allowed unqualified instructors to provide flight training and failed to ensure that several students completed required flight training before concluding their instruction.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has proposed a $306,000 civil penalty against Simulator Center LLC, located in Sanford, Florida.
According to the agency, the pilot training center allegedly allowed unqualified instructors to provide flight training and failed to ensure several students completed required training.
